long_description:
**DALLAS, GET READY FOR OUR MOST SPECIAL NIGHT OF THE YEAR 🪔💗**

This November, we’re bringing NAZAARA Diwali to Dallas for the VERY FIRST TIME 🥹✨

Dallas has quickly become one of our favourite cities. The crowd energy here is always unmatched, so we already know y’all are going to SHOW UP for this one.

Come dressed in your finest and get ready to sing, dance & turn up to the best of Bollywood, along with throwbacks and club bangers all night long with VEER, NEIL & MITHIL behind the decks 🙂‍↔️

We’ve been waiting to bring Diwali to Dallas, and we cannot WAIT to celebrate with you 🪔💗

**✨ Dress Code: Traditional South Asian Attire**

🪔 NAZAARA DIWALI\

💥 Saturday, November 7\

🪔 Johnny Cabron’s Dallas\

💥 VEER • NEIL • MITHIL\

🪔 Bollywood • Throwbacks • Club Bangers

🔞 **21+ Event**
